normalization_notes: ENERGY STAR Enterprise Server certification IDs are immutable issuer identities, not installed deployments.

Low-end, typical/single and high-end SERT configurations remain separately bounded observations; PSU nameplates, SERT idle watts, workload efficiency scores and total-server power scores are not normalized as rated server or rack input.
Maximum supported memory is not treated as installed memory, and processor-socket conflicts remain quarantined rather than resolved from model names.
All 20 Fujitsu PRIMERGY entries retain their exact issuer model, certification identity and numeric processor-socket attribute; no OEM option combination or installed deployment is inferred.

All 31 xFusion entries retain immutable issuer IDs. Platform socket count is not replaced by the separately reported one-, two- or four-processor population in SERT configurations, including rows with -1P and -2P suffixes.
FIN02 decision identifiers and address do not establish capacity or a second construction event.
FIN04 building areas remain building-bound observations and never become campus or data-hall area.
FIN05 60 MW IT, 75 MW first-phase electrical demand and 230 MW whole-project demand remain distinct boundaries; none is treated as grid connection capacity.
FIN05 operator investment and possible customer-owned server/installation investment remain separately scoped observations.
Campus aggregates remain excluded from capacity sums under all viewer filters.
Kehua apparent kVA and active kW remain family-specific published boundaries; neither is derived from the other.
Selectable voltage/frequency, battery, distribution-box, EBM and parallel choices do not create synthesized configurations.
KR33 localized-page conflicts and KR11-RM internal voltage inconsistency remain quarantined rather than silently resolved.
KSTAR kVA and kW remain separate published boundaries; voltage/frequency choices and shared efficiency, dimensions, battery and standard/long-run weight cells are not synthesized.
The KSTAR EPI 30K printed apparent-power inconsistency remains quarantined.

The complete KSTAR EPOWER/EPOWER-L/EPOWER-H continuation is processed at 38 model columns; shared efficiency, cabinet, battery and 6P/12P cells remain observations and never create synthesized variants.
Borri current apparent-kVA and active-kW pairs remain separate reported values; voltage and frequency choices are not selected configurations.
Borri family-level maximum efficiency without a load point, merged dimensions, batteries, communications, parallel kits and transformer options remain observations.
INGENIO PLUS internal-battery autonomy is preserved only at the stated 70% load condition and is not normalized as generic runtime; INGENIO MAX conflicting weights remain quarantined.
Baudouin engine gross mechanical kWm, generator electrical kWe and generator apparent kVA remain distinct exact row boundaries.
Baudouin frequency is part of the configuration identity; speed, aspiration and governor are row-bound observations, while alternator, voltage, emissions and installation choices remain unknown.
Makelsan LEVELUPS, T3 and T4 apparent-kVA and active-kW values remain separate exact table-column ratings; no power factor is derived.

Makelsan selectable voltage/frequency, family efficiency, battery cells, cabinet groupings and communication options remain observations and never create synthesized configurations or generic runtime.
SIEL Safepower S and Evo HF exact kVA/kW pairs remain separate reported boundaries; no power factor is derived.
SIEL Safepower Modular SPM cabinet active kW remains null because the frame table prints cabinet kVA but not cabinet kW.
SIEL merged dimension cells and with/without-internal-battery weight alternatives remain observations; exact single cabinet weights are normalized.
SIEL module, battery, voltage/frequency, communications and parallel options do not create synthesized configurations or inferred runtime/energy.
Tescom exact printed kVA and kW remain separate reported boundaries; no power factor is derived.
Tescom selectable voltage/frequency, battery, communications and module choices remain observations and do not create synthesized configurations, battery energy or runtime.
DS POWER SH battery-qualified dimension alternatives remain observations; only the exact unqualified weights are normalized.
MTI250 cabinet ratings and 25 kVA/25 kW power-module statements remain separate; module counts are not synthesized into additional cabinet variants.
ENERGY STAR Unique ID is the immutable identity for each certification entry; similarly named models are not collapsed across tested configurations.
Para Systems/Minuteman active W and apparent VA are converted exactly to kW and kVA but remain separate; no output power factor is derived.

Normalized runtime is the certified minimum configuration's reported 100% load runtime, with runtime_load_kw converted exactly from its active W rating; the separately reported 50% runtime remains a load-qualified observation.
Weighted and 25/50/75/100% efficiency values retain the minimum-configuration and lowest-input-dependency normal-mode boundary; battery energy and maximum configurations remain unknown.
